_comment: Reconciled to the mature nested manifest shape kart-identity-service/kart-cart-service/kart-product-service/kart-user-service already use (exchanges[]/externalExchanges[]/publishedEvents[]/queues[with deadLetter+retryLadder]/deadLetterQueues[]), superseding kart-platform/docs/services/kart-wishlist-service/message-bus-manifest.json's earlier flatter draft shape (exchange/dlx/queues/dlqs/retry as siblings) - the same reconciliation kart-cart-service's own manifest documents for itself. Queue/DLQ names and retry counts match event-contract.md exactly (ProductPriceChanged/ProductDiscontinued: 3x retry, wishlist.product-events.dlq; UserDataErased: 5x exponential-backoff retry, wishlist.user-events.dlq, compliance-critical tier per ADR-0016 item 7). WishlistPriceAlertTriggered's own consumers (Notification, Analytics) declare their own queues/DLQs bound to wishlist.exchange in their own manifests - not shown here, since a manifest only ever declares the exchanges/queues this service itself owns and directly interacts with.
